components.name: Text Action
components.description: The restrained action style used for clearing filters and retrying loads.
components.css: .ds-text-action { appearance: none; border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0; color: oklch(54.6% 0.245 262.881); font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem Lato, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-text-action:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { border-radius: 0.125rem; outline: 2px solid oklch(54.6% 0.245 262.881); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Underlined Field
components.description: The flat, rule-based field used throughout concert filtering.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; color: oklch(13% 0.028 261.692); font-family: Lato, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.375rem; color: oklch(55.1% 0.027 264.364); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field-control { width: 100%; height: 2.75rem; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(87.2% 0.01 258.338); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: oklch(21% 0.034 264.665); font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem Lato, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-field-control:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(54.6% 0.245 262.881); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(54.6% 0.245 262.881) 25%, transparent); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: A removable pale-blue token for active composer, work, or city filters.
components.html: Claude Debussy
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { display: inline-flex; max-width: 100%; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(54.6% 0.245 262.881) 10%, transparent); padding: 0.125rem 0.125rem 0.125rem 0.625rem; color: oklch(54.6% 0.245 262.881); font: 400 0.75rem/1rem Lato, sans-serif; } .ds-filter-chip button { display: inline-flex; width: 1.75rem; height: 1.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-left: 0.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter-chip button:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(54.6% 0.245 262.881) 10%, transparent); } .ds-filter-chip button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(54.6% 0.245 262.881); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.css: .ds-concert-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 14rem minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0; border: 1px solid oklch(92.8% 0.006 264.531); background: #fff; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; color: oklch(21% 0.034 264.665); font-family: Lato, sans-serif; } .ds-concert-row:hover { background: oklch(98.5% 0.002 247.839); } .ds-concert-date, .ds-concert-title, .ds-composer { font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; } .ds-concert-date span, .ds-composer { color: oklch(55.1% 0.027 264.364); } .ds-concert-title { color: oklch(21% 0.034 264.665); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-concert-title:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-concert-title:focus-visible { border-radius: 0.125rem; outline: 2px solid oklch(54.6% 0.245 262.881); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-concert-meta { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; margin-left: 0.5rem; } .ds-badge-outline, .ds-badge-solid { display: inline-flex; border-radius: 0.375rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-badge-outline { color: oklch(54.6% 0.245 262.881); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(54.6% 0.245 262.881) 50%, transparent); } .ds-badge-solid { background: oklch(54.6% 0.245 262.881); color: #fff; } .ds-composer { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; font-weight: 500; } @media (max-width: 63.999rem) { .ds-concert-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-concert-meta { display: flex; margin: 0.5rem 0; } }

components.name: Autocomplete Overlay
components.description: The temporary elevated list used to search cities, composers, and works.
components.css: .ds-listbox { max-height: 16rem; overflow-y: auto; border: 1px solid oklch(92.8% 0.006 264.531); background: #fff; padding: 0.25rem 0; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); font-family: Lato, sans-serif; } .ds-option { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-option:hover, .ds-option:focus { background: oklch(98.5% 0.002 247.839); outline: none; } .ds-option strong { display: block; color: oklch(21% 0.034 264.665); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; font-weight: 400; } .ds-option small, .ds-count { display: block; color: oklch(55.1% 0.027 264.364); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1rem; } .ds-count { padding-top: 0.125rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
ClassicalBot behaves like a carefully typeset concert programme that happens to contain a worldwide catalogue. The interface is calm, cultured, and direct: expressive serif headings establish an editorial voice while compact sans-serif controls and structured rows keep discovery fast.

The system is refined and restrained rather than ornamental. Gallery-white space, slate typography, fine rules, and measured blue interaction cues let programme data provide the visual interest. Colorful source and location badges are purposeful indexing signals, not decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Light, editorial surfaces with generous whitespace.
Serif hierarchy paired with compact, practical controls.
Fine dividers and underlines instead of enclosing cards.
Programme Blue reserved for links, focus, and active interaction.
Colorful badges used to scan structured concert metadata.

rules.name: The Programme Blue Rule
rules.body: Programme Blue communicates navigation, focus, or active state; it does not become a decorative surface wash.

rules.name: The Gallery Rule
rules.body: Default surfaces remain white, with Gallery Mist appearing only as a subtle response to interaction.

rules.name: The Programme Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Serif type names pages and sections; sans-serif type performs actions, carries metadata, and supports sustained reading.

rules.name: The Quiet Weight Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from family, scale, and space before boldness; serif headings remain regular weight.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting page content has no shadow; elevation marks a temporary layer, never ordinary grouping.

dos: Do let programme data and typography create the hierarchy.
Do preserve Gallery White space and fine Slate rules between dense information.
Do reserve Programme Blue for navigation, focus, and active interaction.
Do keep controls at least 2.75rem tall and preserve explicit keyboard focus.
Do keep interface copy short, factual, and useful.
donts: Don't introduce ornamental redesigns or decorative classical-music motifs.
Don't convert concert rows and page sections into a card-heavy layout.
Don't build dense dashboard chrome around the discovery experience.
Don't use shadows on resting content or ordinary grouping surfaces.
Don't replace useful structured data with long promotional or AI-generated prose.
